AgentCapability.title: AgentCapability
AgentCapability.description: Machine-readable role boundary advertised to the Controller.

AgentResult-Input.title: AgentResult
AgentResult-Input.description: Candidate outputs from an agent; governance fields are intentionally absent.

AgentResult-Output.title: AgentResult
AgentResult-Output.description: Candidate outputs from an agent; governance fields are intentionally absent.

AnalysisModelSpecification.title: AnalysisModelSpecification
AnalysisModelSpecification.description: A replaceable model description; it is not restricted to LMM.

AnalysisReadinessReport.title: AnalysisReadinessReport
AnalysisReadinessReport.description: Readiness assessment before any data operation is dispatched.

ApprovalRequest.title: ApprovalRequest
ApprovalRequest.description: A request that the Controller route to a human approval node.

ArtifactContent.title: ArtifactContent
ArtifactContent.description: A versioned JSON body stored behind an ``ArtifactRef``.

ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef
ArtifactRef.description: A pointer to a versioned artifact; content stays outside ResearchState.

CandidateArtifact.title: CandidateArtifact
CandidateArtifact.description: Transient structured content that only the Controller may persist.

CodeSpecificationDraft.title: CodeSpecificationDraft
CodeSpecificationDraft.description: A draft input for the coding operator; it contains no source code.

ControllerWorkflowState.title: ControllerWorkflowState
ControllerWorkflowState.description: Reference-only state owned and changed by the Controller.

DataAnalysisPreAnalysisOutcome-Input.title: DataAnalysisPreAnalysisOutcome
DataAnalysisPreAnalysisOutcome-Input.description: Complete, proposal-only package returned by PRE_ANALYSIS.

DataAnalysisPreAnalysisOutcome-Output.title: DataAnalysisPreAnalysisOutcome
DataAnalysisPreAnalysisOutcome-Output.description: Complete, proposal-only package returned by PRE_ANALYSIS.

DataAuditSpecification.title: DataAuditSpecification
DataAuditSpecification.description: Rules a deterministic data-audit operator must evaluate.

DataPipelineState.title: DataPipelineState
DataPipelineState.description: Reference-only state for Controller data operations; no file payloads.

DataProcessingPlanCandidate.title: DataProcessingPlanCandidate
DataProcessingPlanCandidate.description: A human-approvable candidate, never a data mutation command.

ExecutableAnalysisPlan.title: ExecutableAnalysisPlan
ExecutableAnalysisPlan.description:
Schema-bound compilation of an approved preregistered plan.

It may map variable names, confirm their types, and select software
settings.  Substantive choices (outcomes, models, covariates, exclusion
rules, or missing-data strategy) remain in the preregistered plan or an
approved amendment.

ExecutableAnalysisPlanCandidate.title: ExecutableAnalysisPlanCandidate
ExecutableAnalysisPlanCandidate.description: Schema mapping proposal that cannot alter preregistered decisions.

ExecutionStatus.title: ExecutionStatus
ExecutionStatus.description: How far deterministic execution and validation have progressed.

InterpretationStatus.title: InterpretationStatus
InterpretationStatus.description: Human review state for an interpretation; distinct from numeric validity.

ManuscriptNumericClaim.title: ManuscriptNumericClaim
ManuscriptNumericClaim.description: One number quoted by a manuscript, with its intended result-card link.

PlanningRunResult.title: PlanningRunResult
PlanningRunResult.description: Result of the planning slice, paused at human approval.

ReproducibilityReviewOutcome.title: ReproducibilityReviewOutcome
ReproducibilityReviewOutcome.description: Only review artifacts; no paper, result, data, or state mutation.

ReproducibilityReviewRequest.title: ReproducibilityReviewRequest
ReproducibilityReviewRequest.description:
Controller input for read-only manuscript-number verification.

Statistical result cards are intentionally not accepted from callers. The
Controller derives the sole permitted card from the project's completed
deterministic data pipeline.

ReproducibilityReviewRunResult.title: ReproducibilityReviewRunResult
ReproducibilityReviewRunResult.description: Controller-routed reviewer output; the Reviewer never sets workflow state.

ResearchState.title: ResearchState
ResearchState.description: Small project ledger; large payloads must remain in stores.

ResultValidationReport.title: ResultValidationReport
ResultValidationReport.description: Deterministic validation result for one or two execution engines.

ReviewFinding.title: ReviewFinding
ReviewFinding.description: One independent-review finding; it never mutates the reviewed artifact.

ReviewReport.title: ReviewReport
ReviewReport.description: Aggregate reviewer output, without approval or release authority.

RevisionRequest.title: RevisionRequest
RevisionRequest.description: A read-only request describing changes that a Controller may route.

StatisticalResultCard.title: StatisticalResultCard
StatisticalResultCard.description:
A card built by a deterministic parser after result validation.

Agents may read this card, but their candidate outputs must never create or
alter its values.

ToolRequest.title: ToolRequest
ToolRequest.description: A request for a deterministic operator; it is not an execution command.

ValidationMode.title: ValidationMode
ValidationMode.description: Whether results received one-engine or cross-engine validation.

WorkflowRunResult.title: WorkflowRunResult
WorkflowRunResult.description: A routed Agent run and the approval required before progression.
